title: Wild Snails
description: A mod that adds the snails from Wild Life.
body: # __**Description**__ **Wild Snails** based on **Wild Life,** it's main feature is a per-player “hunter mob” system: each player can enable a custom mob that relentlessly follows them, lunges at them when close, cannot be killed and instantly kills the player if it gets close enough.   # __**Commands**__ * /huntermob type "mob" (Which allows you to choose the mob that hunts you \[e.g. /huntermob type cat\]) * /huntermob enabled "true" or "false" (Where true turns the hunter mob on and false turns it off) * /huntermob "player" enabled "true or false" (Enables or disables a players hunter mob. Operators get prompted to allow non-op player requests see command below \[Only in 1.1 and above\]) * /permission "yes or no" (Only in 1.1 and above) The Snail will be added as sone as I now how to do it : )   THIS MOD IS STILL IN PROGRESS!!!
